description: This file defines the CRPDF class responsible for generating PDF documents via Chrome DevTools Protocol, including paper size conversions and PDF generation logic.

classes.name: CRPDF
classes.description: Class for generating PDFs using Chrome DevTools Protocol, with methods for converting print parameters and invoking PDF generation.

methods.name: convertPrintParameterToInches
methods.description: Converts a string with units (px, in, cm, mm) to inches as a number.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a PDF buffer based on provided page options, handling paper size, margins, and other settings.
